commentary: A strong Monday for markets, with the pot up £709. Wall Street had its best day since April on hopes of a US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough and lower oil: the S&P 500 rose 2.3% and the Nasdaq 2.7%. Meta jumped 5.1% (about £102) and Microsoft and Amazon each gained about 2.7% to 2.9% (about £84 and £99), but NVIDIA fell 4.3% (about £183) after its board opened an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a woman suspected of spying links to China. In London the FTSE 100 rose 1.0% to 10,782.87, HSBC gained 2.5% (about £247) and the global tracker VWRP added 1.0% (about £330). The pound rose slightly to 1.3437 against the dollar from 1.3356, which trimmed about £138 from the US holdings on its own.
